q: Lyapunov exponents measure the average exponential growth rate of:
opts: Tangent vectors under the linearised flow (infinitesimal separation of nearby trajectories)
The distance from a fixed point
exp: The Lyapunov exponent λ = lim (1/t)log‖Dφₜ(x)v‖ measures how fast nearby orbits separate in the direction v. Positive λ means exponential divergence (chaos); negative λ means contraction.
